title: Code availability is not enough: schemas for documenting and extending data analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.33167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A data analysis involves a sequence of decisions, from data cleaning to model specification, each of which can affect the reported result. Reproducing that result is not the same as understanding the sequence of decisions that produced it and the reasons for each: the code mixes those decisions with implementation details, while the manuscript states the major decisions and their rationale but scatters them across its sections and often leaves out the minor ones. A reader may then ask how the result would change under a different decision: the question itself is easy to pose, but implementing it is often non-trivial in practice. In this work, we propose a schema that represents a data analysis as a collection of decisions in natural language, from which large language models (LLMs) can generate and validate analysis scripts directly. translated_title: 代码可用性还不够：用于记录和扩展数据分析的架构
translated_abstract: 数据分析涉及一系列决策，从数据清洗到模型设定，每一项决策都可能影响最终报告的结果。复现该结果并不等同于理解产生该结果的决策序列及每项决策背后的理由：代码将这些决策与实现细节混杂在一起，而论文手稿虽然陈述了主要决策及其理由，却将其分散在各个章节中，并且常常遗漏次要决策。读者因此可能会问，如果采用不同的决策，结果将如何变化：这个问题本身很容易提出，但在实践中实现起来往往并不简单。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种架构，将数据分析表示为一组以自然语言描述的决策，大型语言模型可以直接从中生成并验证分析脚本。这一工作流程还可以将单一分析扩展为完整的多元宇宙分析，其规范以一种方式指定（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种用自然语言记录数据分析中各项决策的架构，使大型语言模型能够据此生成并验证分析脚本，还能将单一分析自动扩展为多元分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a schema that represents data analysis decisions in natural language, enabling LLMs to generate and validate analysis scripts and to expand a single analysis into a full multiverse of alternatives.
